content.text:
Here are the 10 newest hoodie ads in the GetHookd library. They all started running yesterday (2026-10-30), are still active, and are filed under apparel.

| # | Brand | Headline | Format | Countries | Hook in the body copy |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Bright Craft | Save 30% on the hoodie everyone is talking about | Image | US, JP | 60-day risk-free trial, satisfaction guarantee |
| 2 | Blue Supply | Why thousands switched to this hoodie | Image | GB, NL, JP | Free shipping over $100, 90-day trial |
| 3 | Vivid Goods | Meet the hoodie customers keep buying | Image | CA | 4.2★ from 8,033 customers, "limited stock" |
| 4 | Nova Bloom | Eco-friendly hoodie for gift season | Carousel | GB, DE, ES, IT | Limited stock, 30-day trial |
| 5 | Golden Nest | Save 35% on the hoodie everyone is talking about | Video | US, AU, NL | "Designed for every budget," 60-day trial |
| 6 | Vivid Nest | The hoodie you will actually use | Image | DE, ES, BR, MX | Lightweight materials, "busy mornings" |
| 7 | Kind Studio | Our premium hoodie just dropped | Carousel | FR | Free shipping over $50, delivery by Monday |
| 8 | Green Club | Our premium hoodie just dropped | Video | US, CA, AU | Free shipping over $70, everyday use |
| 9 | Bright Nest | Our bestselling hoodie just dropped | Image | SE, MX, JP | 5★ from 659 customers, limited stock |
| 10 | True Supply | Save 40% on the hoodie everyone is talking about | Carousel | IT, MX, JP | Free shipping over $50, delivery by Tuesday |

**Patterns:**
- **The headlines repeat across brands.** "Save X% on the hoodie everyone is talking about" appears three times, with discounts of 30%, 35% and 40%. "Our premium/bestselling hoodie just dropped" also appears three times.
- **Most rely on reducing risk or creating urgency:** free trials (30–90 days), free-shipping minimums ($50–$100), "limited stock" and delivery dates.
- **Every ad ends with "Pair it with our…"** to suggest another item, such as chinos, a jacket or a t-shirt.
- **Only Nova Bloom ties the ad to the season** ("gift season"). None mention Halloween or cold weather.
- **Formats:** 5 image, 3 carousel, 2 video.

Three ads have impression ranks: Bright Craft #14, Green Club #20 and Kind Studio #60. Those ranks only compare ads within the same brand, so they can't tell you which brand's ad is seen more.

I can load the next page, narrow it to a format (like video only), widen it to a longer date range, or open any ad's full text.
